verdict.rationale: Quo's own documented features run without a person present. Sona answers calls when the team can't and hands conversations off, recorded calls are automatically transcribed and summarized, and calls are routed by configurable ring orders and phone menus. The evidence shows no general user-configurable automation or workflow builder, and the API and MCP server are developer building blocks that earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined automation builder (triggers, actions, schedules), recurring or scheduled background jobs, detail on how Sona's behavior is configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Custom ring orders ... Call transfers ... Phone menus
